summary: Scoped prototype audit: strict owner registration, verified instructor authority, exact known-mission totals, immutable reviewed-score audits and roster-private snapshots. Production rollout and operational privacy review remain necessary.

findings.issue: Class snapshots are deliberate publications; opting out does not rewrite an already published snapshot, and preference changes can race the teacher's publication read.
findings.recommendation: Disclose snapshot semantics, promptly republish on removal requests, and consider a separately designed server-maintained revocation flow before a real-time leaderboard.

findings.issue: Rules restrict class publication to verified instructors and limit document size by row count, but do not independently certify each alias-only row against the separate reviewed score and current consent record.
findings.recommendation: Use the curated publication path, retain trusted staff review, and design stronger server-side projection if untrusted staff or externally writable integrations are introduced.

findings.issue: Students control their private completion claims. Completion and reflection are not proof of correctness or independent work.
findings.recommendation: Do not rank self-recorded totals. Require documented instructor verification of known mission IDs before trusted points are recorded.
